---

## Objective

Automatically identify regions where vegetation patterns are predominantly terrain-driven across diverse hydroclimatic and latitudinal backgrounds, in order to validate the framework proposed by Fan et al. (2019).

---

## Input Data

```{r DataPre}
# Load resampled raster datasets (MI, TWI, fused)
mi_55km_r <- terra::rast(mi_55km_file) * 0.0001
fused_55km_r <- terra::rast(fused_55km_file)
fbare_55km_r <- terra::rast(fbare_55km_file)
fwater_55km_r <- terra::rast(fwater_55km_file)
fsnow_55km_r <- terra::rast(fsnow_55km_file)
dem_sd_55km_r <- terra::rast(dem_sd_55km_path)
dem_rg_95p_05p_55km_r <- terra::rast(dem_rg_95p_05p_55km_path)
fpa_55km_r <- terra::rast(fpa_55km_path)
fveg_55km_r <- terra::rast(fveg_real_55km_path)

# mi_55km_r
# fused_55km_r
# fbare_55km_r
# fwater_55km_r
# fsnow_55km_r
# dem_sd_55km_r
# dem_rg_95p_05p_55km_r
# fpa_55km_r
# fveg_55km_r

# Stack rasters with explicit layer names
stacked <- c(
  mi_55km_r, fused_55km_r, fbare_55km_r, fwater_55km_r, fsnow_55km_r,
  dem_sd_55km_r, dem_rg_95p_05p_55km_r, fpa_55km_r, fveg_55km_r
)

# Convert to data.frame
df <- na.omit(as.data.frame(stacked, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE))

rm(stacked)
gc()

# Rename columns for clarity
colnames(df) <- c(
  "lon", "lat", "mi", "fused", "fbare", "fwater", "fsnow", "relief",
  "dem_rg_95p_05p", "fpa", "fveg"
)

# Clean up
rm(mi_55km_r, fused_55km_r, fbare_55km_r, fwater_55km_r, fsnow_55km_r,
   dem_sd_55km_r, dem_rg_95p_05p_55km_r, fpa_55km_r, fveg_55km_r)
gc()

# Load coastline for visualization
coast <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline(scale = 110, returnclass = "sf")
```

---

## Variable Binning

```{r Bin, echo = TRUE}
df_binned <- df |>
  mutate(
    # MI bins (aridity)
    mi_bin = cut(mi, breaks = c(0, 0.03, 0.2, 0.5, 0.65, 1, Inf), include.lowest = TRUE),
    # Relief bins (low vs high)
    relief_bin = cut(relief, breaks = quantile(relief, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/2), na.rm = TRUE), include.lowest = TRUE),
    # Latitude bins
    abs_lat = abs(lat),
    abs_lat_bin = cut(abs_lat, breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60), include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # MI labels (1–6)
    mi_label = case_when(
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[1] ~ "1_hyper_arid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[2] ~ "2_arid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[3] ~ "3_semiarid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[4] ~ "4_dry_subhumid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[5] ~ "5_humid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[6] ~ "6_perhumid"
    ),
    # Relief labels
    relief_label = case_when(
      relief_bin == levels(relief_bin)[1] ~ "low_relief",
      relief_bin == levels(relief_bin)[2] ~ "high_relief"
    ),
    # Latitude labels (1–5)
    lat_label = case_when(
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[1] ~ "1_00_10_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[2] ~ "2_10_20_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[3] ~ "3_20_30_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[4] ~ "4_30_40_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[5] ~ "5_40_50_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[6] ~ "6_50_60_lat"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Combined strata label
    strata_label = paste0(mi_label, "_", lat_label, "_", relief_label)
  ) |>
  select(-mi_label, -relief_label, -lat_label)

# Check bin distributions
table(df_binned$mi_bin)
table(df_binned$abs_lat_bin)
table(df_binned$relief_bin)
table(df_binned$strata_label)
df_binned[df_binned$lon == 14.25 & df_binned$lat == -21.25, ]
```

---

## Filtering Candidate Regions

```{r Filter, echo = TRUE}
df_filt <- df_binned |>
  filter(relief_bin %in% levels(relief_bin)[c(2)]) |>            # Keep high relief only
  filter(fused < 0.03) |>                                        # Exclude high human activity
  filter(fsnow < 0.1) |>                                         # Avoid snow/ice-dominated areas
  filter(fwater < 0.3) |>                                        # Avoid water-dominated areas
  filter(fveg > 0.5) |>                                          # Require sufficient vegetation cover
  filter(fpa > 0.5) |>                                           # Prefer protected areas (≥50%)
  filter(dem_rg_95p_05p < 500)                                   # Limit elevation range

# Check remaining samples per bin
table(df_filt$mi_bin)
table(df_filt$abs_lat_bin)
table(df_filt$relief_bin)
table(df_filt$strata_label)
```

---

## Sampling Representative Locations

```{r Sampling}
set.seed(1)

# Function: Select 6 samples with the following constraints:
# - First number (MI bin): 1–6 each exactly once
# - Second number (latitude bin): 1–4 each ≥1, 5 exactly once
# (Only one sample from latitude bin 5 due to high-latitude uncertainty in VEGH data)

# Step 1: Randomly sample one row per strata_label
sampled_all <- df_filt |>
  group_by(strata_label) |>
  slice_sample(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    xmin = round(lon - 0.25, 1),
    xmax = round(lon + 0.25, 1),
    ymin = round(lat - 0.25, 1),
    ymax = round(lat + 0.25, 1),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
    sample_id = ""
  )

# Step 2: Manually select 6 labels meeting constraints
selected_labels <- c(
  "1_hyper_arid_3_20_30_lat_high_relief",  
  "2_arid_1_00_10_lat_high_relief",         
  "3_semiarid_2_10_20_lat_high_relief",    
  "4_dry_subhumid_4_30_40_lat_high_relief",
  "5_humid_6_50_60_lat_high_relief",     
  "6_perhumid_5_40_50_lat_high_relief"
)

# Step 3: Add selection indicator column
sampled_all <- sampled_all |>
  mutate(is_selected = strata_label %in% selected_labels)

sampled_all |> filter(is_selected)
# Step 4: Save full dataset with selection indicator
saveRDS(sampled_all, reg_sample_info_path)
```

## Export and Visualization

```{r loadinfo}
# Load region info
reg_info_full <- readRDS(reg_sample_info_path) 
reg_info_full <- reg_info_full |>
  mutate(label_num = row_number())

# 使用 reorder 按 label_num 排序
reg_info_full <- reg_info_full %>%
  mutate(
    display_label = paste(label_num, "-", strata_label),
    display_label = reorder(display_label, label_num)  # 按 label_num 排序
  )
reg_info <- reg_info_full |> filter(is_selected)
```

```{r plot_location, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
reg_info_full

# World map
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
text_size <- 12

p_loc <- ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf(fill = "gray95", color = "gray70") +
  geom_point(
    data = reg_info_full,
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, fill = display_label),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = reg_info_full,
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, label = label_num),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-60, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Region Locations",
    fill = "Strata Label"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2,  # 图例显示为2列
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = text_size) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(size = text_size * 0.9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = text_size * 0.7),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = text_size * 0.8, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = text_size * 0.8, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = text_size * 1.2, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

print(p_loc)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("data/figures/5_01_sample_region_location_all.png"),
  plot = p_loc,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  device = "png",
  bg = "transparent"
)
```

```{r plot_sample_vegh}
vegh_master <- terra::rast(vegh_450m_mosaic_path)

plot_vegh_by_reg <- function(reg_row, vegh_master, text_size = 12) {
  reg_id <- paste0(reg_row$strata_label, "_", reg_row$sample_id)
  reg_extent <- terra::ext(reg_row$xmin, reg_row$xmax, reg_row$ymin, reg_row$ymax)

  vegh_cropped <- terra::crop(vegh_master, reg_extent)
  names(vegh_cropped) <- "vegh"

  p_vegh <- plot_vegh(vegh_cropped, extent = reg_extent, title_text = reg_id,
                      text_size = text_size, x_step = 0.5, y_step = 0.5) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

  rm(vegh_cropped)
  return(p_vegh)
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(reg_info_full))) {
  p <- plot_vegh_by_reg(reg_info_full[i, ], vegh_master)
  print(p)
}

rm(vegh_master)
gc()
```
